name: Cinderwake
description: A broad charcoal steel sword with a clipped chisel point, two wide orange inset channels, a forked bronze flame crossguard, burgundy wrapped grip and amber diamond pommel. Strong angular silhouette.

name: Moonwell Fang
description: A gently curved silver saber with a long tapering fang point, a deep blue inset along the blade, a silver crescent crossguard, dark teal wrapped grip and round moonstone pommel. Slender flowing silhouette.

name: Briar Oath
description: A tall pointed kite shield of dark forest-green wood with an aged bronze rim, two branching ivory antler-like roots rising from an emerald heart gem, and sharp leaf-shaped shoulders. The branching roots dominate its face.

name: Dawnglass
description: An octagonal shield, broad and nearly round, divided into four large alternating pale cyan and apricot glass panes by thick golden spokes, a gold eight-point sun surrounding an amber diamond at center, and a heavy beveled golden rim. Opaque luminous glass.

name: Ashen Pilgrim
description: An unworn oxblood short-sleeved adventurer tunic with a split charcoal scarf collar, dark bronze angular shoulder plates, a prominent orange flame-shaped chest brooch, charcoal belt and bronze angular hem trim. Compact cloth silhouette, no body or mannequin.

name: Veil of the Deep
description: An unworn midnight navy short-sleeved tunic with a high pale cyan wave-shaped collar, a prominent silver crescent and turquoise teardrop chest clasp, scalloped cyan hem trim and silver belt buckle. Compact cloth silhouette, no body or mannequin.

name: Wayfarer's Promise
description: A pair of chestnut brown traveling boots with tall rolled ivory cuffs, teal crossed ankle straps, thick dark soles and prominent bronze four-point compass buckles on the shins. Rounded practical toes, one boot slightly behind the other.

name: Redstep
description: A pair of charcoal leather boots armored with pointed deep red shin plates, split red cuffs, bronze diagonal laces and broad bronze toe caps. Aggressive angular silhouette, one boot slightly behind the other.

name: Briarwatch blade
description: A broad leaf-shaped green steel sword with an ivory central vein, antler-shaped bronze guard, forest-green grip and emerald leaf pommel. The blade widens near its upper half and narrows to a spear point.

name: Briarwatch shield
description: A large leaf-shaped forest-green shield with a bronze border, raised ivory branching leaf veins and an elongated emerald central leaf. Pointed top and bottom, broad rounded shoulders, sculpted wood grain.

name: Briarwatch tunic
description: An unworn forest-green short-sleeved tunic with layered bronze leaf shoulder plates, ivory split collar, a large emerald leaf clasp on the chest and an ivory vine pattern along its pointed hem. Brown belt, no body or mannequin.

name: Briarwatch boots
description: A pair of forest-green leather boots with bronze leaf-shaped shin guards, ivory branching vine inlays, thick brown soles and emerald leaf clasps at the cuffs. Rounded toes, one boot slightly behind the other.

name: Cinderbound blade
description: A broad dark gunmetal sword with a flame-shaped jagged upper blade, a large orange chevron inset, an angular bronze wing crossguard, oxblood grip and orange diamond pommel. Heavy forged silhouette.

name: Cinderbound shield
description: An angular hexagonal charcoal steel tower shield with a flared top, bronze border, three huge orange flame chevrons descending its face and an amber diamond near the top. Broad, heavy forged silhouette.

name: Cinderbound tunic
description: An unworn charcoal short-sleeved tunic with oxblood collar and skirt panels, angular bronze shoulder plates, three orange flame chevrons at the chest, a bronze belt and a zigzag orange hem. No body or mannequin.

name: Cinderbound boots
description: A pair of charcoal armored boots with broad bronze stepped shin plates, orange flame chevron inlays, oxblood cuffs and squared bronze toe caps. Heavy forged silhouette, one boot slightly behind the other.

name: Tidecaller blade
description: A slender silver sword with a gently waved double-edged blade, turquoise central fuller, a silver seashell crossguard with three pronounced ridges, navy wrapped grip and turquoise pearl pommel. Elegant pointed silhouette.

name: Tidecaller shield
description: A wide navy shield shaped like a scallop shell, with five scalloped lobes across its upper edge, a tapered base, thick silver border, five broad raised pale cyan radial ribs and a turquoise pearl at the bottom center.

name: Tidecaller tunic
description: An unworn navy short-sleeved tunic with pale cyan scalloped collar and hem, silver shell shoulder plates, a large five-ribbed silver seashell and turquoise pearl clasp on the chest and silver belt. No body or mannequin.

name: Tidecaller boots
description: A pair of navy leather boots with flared pale cyan scalloped cuffs, silver shell-shaped shin guards with five radial ribs, turquoise pearl clasps and silver toe caps. Elegant rounded silhouette, one boot slightly behind the other.
